ModMetaData.name: Save Our Ship 2
ModMetaData.description:
Save Our Ship 2 is an unofficial expansion for RimWorld. Build a liveable spaceship and continue your colonists' stories in orbit - engaging in ship-to-ship combat with pirates, searching derelicts for treasure, and perhaps even discovering a phenomenal cosmic secret or two! SoS2 includes two custom endings: build the Johnson-Tanaka drive to transport your colonists to a different rimworld for a New Game+ experience, or evolve one your colonists to machine godhood using the Archotech Spore.
Main official Github: https://github.com/KentHaeger/SaveOurShip2 Up to date maintained Guthub version: https://github.com/Bqr1s/SaveOurShip2
Save Our Ship 2.8 Tactical Update Featuring new accuracy system: - Ships can now completely dodge enemy shots. Small and fast ships have much better chances to dodge than large slow ships. - Dodge chance depends hugely on Thrust to Weight Ratio. Large cruisers won't dodge, but small fighters will. - Now there is use for manning pilot console in battle! Pilot intellectual skill will increase dodge chance. - Dodge chance also depends on weapon range. It is much easier to dodge railgun shots than cannon shots. - For shots that weren't dodged completely, weapon accuracy now varies greatly. Mechanics are similar to dodge chance. - There is Odyssey integration for new mechanics. Pilot Assistant on player ship pilot will give dodge bonus. - Odyssey gravship can land in SOS 2 space, can be built/upgraded there too. Vacuum gear, implants, genes are also compatible. - Odyssey compatibility is not final yet.
SoS2's return would not have been possible without the tireless work of community volunteers. Featuring user-created ship designs, major community maintenance updates, and more, SoS2 owes thanks to:
